title: Valid: sanitized report (PRD example)
description: Search, sanitize, summarize, ask for confirmation, then email. Passes every check and uses exactly its budget of 5 calls.

title: Valid: confirmed delete
description: delete_file guarded by a confirm result held in a let variable.

title: Optimizer: folding, dead code, duplicate call
description: Constant folding removes the debug branch and the duplicate web_search is merged: 4 tool calls before, 2 after.

title: M7: parallel rounds
description: Three independent searches run in one round: 4 rounds before scheduling, 2 after.

title: Error 1: unterminated string
description: The string literal never closes before the end of the line.

title: Error 1: illegal character
description: '#' is not a character of the language.

title: Error 2: missing semicolon
description: The let statement on line 6 has no ';'. The error points just after the last token of that line.

title: Error 3: undeclared variable
description: x is used but never declared.

title: Error 3: duplicate variable
description: a is declared twice in the same scope.

title: Error 4: type mismatch
description: web_search expects a string, but gets the int 42.

title: Error 4: missing return
description: When flag is false the task reaches its end without returning a bool.

title: Error 5: tool not permitted
description: read_file is called but only llm is permitted.

title: Error 6: budget exceeded
description: Four tool calls on the worst path, budget is 3. The error points at the fourth call.

title: Error 7: prompt injection (taint)
description: The PRD example without sanitize: the untrusted search result flows through llm into send_email.

title: Error 8: irreversible call without confirm
description: When force is true, delete_file runs on a path that skips confirm entirely.

title: Error 9: confirm on only one branch
description: confirm is asked only when careful is true, and its result guards nothing; delete_file after the if is reachable without approval.

title: Error 10: runtime budget guard
description: The loop count is a runtime value, so the compiler warns and the VM enforces the budget: times = 5 trips the guard on the 4th call.

title: Runtime: index out of range
description: The mock search returns 3 results, so results[9] fails in the VM.
